offering_description.value: Operates broadband, fiber, wireless and cable networks serving consumers, businesses and carriers in the US and Caribbean. Also provides wholesale and carrier services, and builds and leases network infrastructure, including government-funded rural broadband and tower assets.

primary_services.value: residential broadband and video; enterprise and carrier data services; mobile wireless; wholesale network transport; fiber and tower infrastructure leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential broadband, mobile and video subscribers; B2B: enterprises, wireless carriers and wholesale telecom customers; B2G: government agencies and programs, including subsidized rural broadband and public-sector connectivity

end_markets.value: telecommunications; residential broadband; enterprise connectivity; wireless carrier infrastructure; rural broadband

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly broadband, mobile and video service plans; service fees: enterprise, carrier and wholesale network services; rental or leasing: tower and fiber capacity leases to carriers; project or contract: government-funded network build and construction contracts
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; rental or leasing; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs fiber, cable, wireless and tower networks, selling to consumers, businesses and carriers; service provider: provides telecom services using owned network infrastructure

specialization.value: related lines: broadband, mobile wireless, cable video, wholesale and carrier services, and infrastructure leasing
